output.reason: On its own, [ev-6c97458131e0] is a bare list item, but the section around it says what it means. [ev-b07a4021f30c] says Loki 3.0 adds a `service_name` label to all ingested logs by default, using the first label it finds from an ordered list. `container_name` is eighth in that list ([ev-92063a2a5bac] through [ev-ea984d665a12]); if no listed label is found, the value is `unknown_service`. So a stream that has `container_name` but none of the seven labels ahead of it gets a new `service_name` label with that value, and operators can edit or disable this through `discover_service_name` in `limits_config`.
